aliases: Master of Science in Computer Science
courses.summary: M.Sc. Computer Science is the Students Traffic catalogue category for postgraduate degrees that develop advanced computer-science knowledge through technical study, practical work and a substantial independent project. The precise academic background required, curriculum, fee and delivery route must be assessed from the university's current programme information.

courses.name: M.Sc. in Data Science
aliases: Master of Science in Data Science
courses.summary: This catalogue category covers postgraduate Master of Science degrees in data science, usually one to two years after a bachelor's degree with a quantitative or computing background. Programmes typically cover statistics, machine learning, programming, databases and big-data tools, data visualisation and applied projects, often with industry internships or capstone work.

courses.name: Master of Computer Applications
courses.summary: The Master of Computer Applications is a two-year postgraduate degree in applied computing, open to graduates who have studied computing or mathematics at undergraduate level. Study covers advanced programming, algorithms, database management, software engineering, computer networks and web technologies, with electives such as machine learning, cloud computing, data analytics and cyber security, and usually a major project or industry internship. Graduates typically work as software developers, systems analysts or IT consultants, and some continue to doctoral research in computer applications.

universities.summary: Periyar University is a state public university established in Salem on 17 September 1997. It offers university-department teaching and research alongside affiliated-college and distance-education routes. The regular campus programmes below belong to its Salem university departments.
universities.campusLifestyle: Students can use the central and department libraries, sports facilities, National Service Scheme, Youth Red Cross and Women’s Studies Centre. Campus amenities include a Computer Centre, Indoor Stadium, bank, post office and transport services. Activities and facilities support university study; access and timetables depend on the relevant department.
universities.cityProfile: The university is at Periyar Palkalai Nagar in Salem, Tamil Nadu. Its prospectus describes bus, rail and air connections. The Dharmapuri Centre for Post Graduate and Research Studies is a separate teaching location; Salem department facts should not be transferred to that centre.
universities.practicalExposure: The regular department curricula use the Choice Based Credit System. Computer Science and Data Science include practical courses and projects, while History includes a core industry project, internship and extension activity. These are curricular requirements rather than a promise of a paid placement.
universities.hostelOverview: The university lists separate hostels for boys and girls. Current room availability, accommodation charges and admission arrangements require confirmation. An academic admission or a historical fee table does not establish a reserved room or a current residential package.
universities.dietarySupport: A current hostel menu and programme-specific meal charge are not verified. Applicants with dietary requirements should obtain the hostel’s current meal arrangements and accommodation quote before choosing a room.
universities.safetyOverview: The campus lists a Health Centre. The mandatory disclosure describes medical support from a doctor and team. These facilities do not establish emergency response times or a personal-safety guarantee; students should obtain current campus contacts when joining.
universities.studentSupport: The Career Guidance and Placement Cell organises recruitment and pooled campus drives and training activities. General and department libraries, the Women’s Studies Centre and student-service groups support campus study. The university requires eligibility certification for applicants whose qualifying degree comes from another university.

faq.question: Is this the Salem university or Periyar Maniammai?
faq.answer: This is Periyar University, a state public university in Salem established on 17 September 1997. Periyar Maniammai in Thanjavur is a separate institution.

faq.question: Are these programmes regular campus degrees?
faq.answer: Yes. The 2026–27 admission notice lists these programmes under regular-mode University Departments in Salem. They are distinct from the Dharmapuri centre, affiliated-college and distance-education routes.

faq.question: Which programmes are taught in English?
faq.answer: The applicable regulations explicitly identify English for M.Sc. Computer Science, M.Sc. Data Science, MCA and M.A. History. A syllabus written in English does not by itself establish the medium of other degrees.

faq.question: Who can enter Computer Science?
faq.answer: The regulation lists computing qualifications including B.Sc. Computer Science, BCA, Computer Technology, Information Science/Technology, several AI and Cyber Security variants, IoT, Data Science and B.Voc. AR & VR. University equivalence conditions apply.

faq.question: Who can enter Data Science?
faq.answer: The listed routes include relevant engineering, computing, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics and Electronics degrees, BCA and B.Com. Computer Applications. A degree containing Mathematics or Computer Science is also listed, subject to the university’s accepted qualification pattern and equivalence assessment.

faq.question: Who can enter History?
faq.answer: Any graduate may apply for the two-year M.A. History. The department gives preference to History graduates. The 2026–27 notice lists this programme under direct admission.

faq.question: What are the MCA academic requirements?
faq.answer: A recognized undergraduate degree and at least 50% marks are required, reduced to 45% for reserved categories. Mathematics at school or degree level is preferred; applicants without it must complete the prescribed Mathematics and Computer Science bridge courses.

faq.question: Can foreign nationals and NRIs apply?
faq.answer: The 2025–26 prospectus permits eligible foreign nationals and NRIs with valid passport/Indian visa documentation and earmarks 10% supernumerary PG seats. General Turn conditions apply. MCA is published here as a domestic route because current programme-specific international permission is not verified.

faq.question: When does the academic year start?
faq.answer: The verified regular-department calendar records odd-semester reopening on 1 July 2025; the same CBCS scope includes semester I in July–November. This is a historical July baseline. The next cycle needs its own commencement confirmation.

faq.question: Are applications currently open?
faq.answer: The 2026–27 notice specified 31 May 2026 for online applications and 10 June 2026 for hard copies. Those dates have passed. Check the next official department notice before applying or paying.

faq.question: What are tuition and accommodation charges?
faq.answer: Current charges are on request. The linked tuition schedule is dated 2024 and the prospectus tables cover 2025–26. Obtain a new programme- and applicant-category breakdown, separating tuition, admission, examination, laboratory, insurance, hostel and meals.

faq.question: Which documents are needed?
faq.answer: The prospectus requests the application printout and self-attested SSLC, Higher Secondary and UG mark statements, community certificate where applicable and transfer certificate. Other-university qualifications require Periyar eligibility certification. Foreign/NRI applicants also need the applicable status documents.

faq.question: Are hostel and student-support facilities available?
faq.answer: The university lists separate boys’ and girls’ hostels, libraries, a Computer Centre, Health Centre and Indoor Stadium. The placement cell organises recruitment activities. Hostel availability and any placement outcome require separate confirmation.
